SHARED-F-2-S48.title: Consent Data Schema and Persistence Model
SHARED-F-2-S48.description: Define and implement data schema for storing consent tier, timestamps, user decisions, and de-identified artifacts. Ensure compatibility with MongoDB persistence patterns and downstream services.

SHARED-F-2-S49.title: Consent API Endpoints and Tool Interface
SHARED-F-2-S49.description: Expose consent workflow via FastAPI endpoints and tool_router integration, enabling initiation, update, and retrieval of consent state during conversations.

SHARED-F-2-S50.title: Lead Capture Integration with Consent Tiers
SHARED-F-2-S50.description: Integrate ConsentService with LeadService to enforce consent tier requirements before storing identifiable user data, including Tier 2 validation and rejection handling.

SHARED-F-2-S51.title: Consent Audit Logging and Compliance Traceability
SHARED-F-2-S51.description: Implement audit logging for all consent decisions, including tier transitions, timestamps, and data handling outcomes, ensuring traceability for compliance and debugging.
